semantic.justification: Complete original UCB content, listener, provider, manager and five-base broker interface declarations use normal CPPU factories. ContentEvent, ContentProviderInfo, NumberedSortingInfo and both open argument values retain IDL defaults, base/member order, owned Reference/Sequence/RTL fields, copies, comparisons and actual Any transport. OpenMode and ContentAction retain original constants. Tests use actual identifiers, active sinks, streams and nested native sequences; no content/provider/broker/context implementation is fabricated. Real Content client, service factory, default resolver, DocumentBuilder, native metadata and DOCX/XLSX/UI orchestration remain incomplete. Physical C++ ABI/threading and implicit move operations are unqualified.
